svg.aria-label: S8 Fetch and the instruction cache: VIPT lookup to the instruction queue
svg.text: S8 Fetch and the instruction cache: VIPT lookup to the instruction queue
The iTLB and the six-way L1I are read together from the virtual address. The physical tag confirms the way. Predecoded lines form fetch groups that queue for decode.
Its depth is not published. An empty queue is bypassed.
Bit 14 is above the page offset, which gives one alias bit.
The fetch predictor holds the way and PA.
A bit per line says it still holds.
Only that way is read, without the iTLB.
Otherwise the tag compares pick the way.
PC-relative targets keep their 14 low bits.
A line comes from the L2 in 17 cycles.
Up to 8 instructions are fetched a cycle.
The first taken branch ends the group.
A page split costs a second cycle.
The page split paper reads 16 a line.
Knowledge base: l1i.size, l1i.line, l1i.assoc, itlb.org, itlb.entries, fetch.width, fetch.taken_per_cycle, dtlb.page_size, iq.depth, l1i_vipt
